footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to H&R Block: after $2.7M of discontinued operations, $964K of preferred dividends. The income statement has no operating income line; it is shown here as revenue less the operating expense lines, with interest and other non-operating items below it.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Jun 30, 2026 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 4.9% to $3.9B in fiscal 2026 (ended Jun 30, 2026). Gross margin was 44.3%, versus 44.5% a year earlier, and operating income rose 9.6% to $908M, a 23.0% margin.
Net income rose 20.8% to $733M, or $5.66 per share. Operating cash flow was $839M and free cash flow $756M, versus $599M; H&R Block returned $211M through dividends.
sources: H&R Block, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2026 (SEC EDGAR)
